concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-016 mandates that the raw PR dataset schema include a `first_comment_timestamp` field (ISO‑8601) capturing the earliest review comment. The current `raw_prs.schema.yaml` lists required fields but omits `first_comment_timestamp`, creating a mismatch between the specification and the declared schema. This could cause downstream scripts (e.g., `compute_metrics.py`) to fail or to fall back to a limitation note unexpectedly.
